sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's geothermal pipeline (BATR, POWR) is structurally supported by PLN's 2030 baseload targets and rising carbon credit monetization, making it the most durable local growth driver.

Solar and water infrastructure (FSLR, AWK) face policy tailwinds from IRA subsidies and municipal replacement cycles, but margins hinge on tariff clarity and rate-case approvals.
sectors.ai: Buy selective laggards with proven execution: BATR and POWR lead on Indonesian geothermal/utility momentum, while EIX/PCG offer US rate-driven upside. Avoid broad beta; rotate into names with contracted cash flows (AWK, SRE) and solar manufacturing (FSLR) as rate cuts price in. Trim on any 5%+ pop without fundamental follow-through.

Accumulate on dips toward 0.39% aggregate, targeting KIJA and TOWR for 3-6 month upside as government capex accelerates ahead of 2025 elections.

Obesity and metabolic drug pipelines (LLY, PODD) are shifting care delivery toward chronic disease management, creating durable demand for delivery devices and companion diagnostics.
sectors.ai: Healthcare's aggregate uptick is broad-based, not idiosyncratic, with global large-caps (LLY, ABBV, JNJ) and Indonesia's RSGK/LABS confirming a risk-on rotation into defensive growth. Buy pullbacks in CSL (plasma pricing power) and RSGK (domestic hospital consolidation), but trim PODD after its 5.96% pop—valuation is stretched. Position for sustained M&A and GLP-1 spillover into diagnostics and distribution.
